title: Machine Intelligence in Africa: a survey

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the top 10 machine intelligence chatbots by prompting them with basic translation and counting tasks across 200 African languages (e.g., Tommo-So Dogon) to demonstrate the lack of representation and capability for low-resource and primarily oral languages.

Analyzing and critiquing existing global AI readiness and adoption indexes to expose Western-centric evaluation methodologies, underrepresentation of African authors, and the failure to account for local cultural contexts and informal economies.

Examining data sources (like LinkedIn or Twitter) and citation counts used in AI indexes to show how they structurally under-represent the African continent and the Global South in AI development metrics.
